Answer: D
Reason: The combination of right lung hypoplasia/atelectasis, right pleural effusion, and a prominent left second cardiac arc (suggesting an enlarged pulmonary artery or anomalous venous return) is characteristic of Scimitar syndrome (partial anomalous pulmonary venous return), where the right pulmonary veins drain anomalously into the systemic circulation.
